facts.text: MetaDrive is a driving simulator with synthesised road maps and traffic, sensor simulation, and point-cloud, RGB/depth/semantic, top-down map and first-person view inputs
The documented usage imports MetaDriveEnv, calls reset() for (obs, info), calls step() for the five-value (obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info) tuple and calls close()
BaseEnv subclasses gymnasium.Env, so MetaDriveEnv (a BaseEnv) is a Gymnasium environment
BaseEnv.step takes one action (or a per-agent dict), preprocesses it, steps the simulator and returns through _get_step_return
For a single agent, _get_step_return returns observation, reward, terminated and truncated values and an info dict
BaseEnv.reset(seed) resets the simulation, clears the episode counters and returns _get_reset_return(reset_info)
The reset seed is applied through _reset_global_seed(seed)
The seed(seed) method calls set_global_random_seed(seed)
When discrete_action is False, the input space is a Box from -1.0 to 1.0 with shape (2,)
The continuous action is converted to a (steering, throttle) pair and clipped to -1.0..1.0
discrete_action defaults to False
The state observation is a Box from -0.0 to 1.0 whose width is ego_state_obs_dim (6) plus the navigation dimension plus the line-detector dimension
The default lidar state observation adds the lidar rays (num_lasers plus 4 * num_others) to the state width and is likewise bounded by 0.0..1.0
The default vehicle lidar has 240 lasers, 0 others and a 50 m distance
The navigation constants are NUM_WAY_POINT 2 and CHECK_POINT_INFO_DIM 5
A physics step is 0.02 s and decision_repeat repeats it 5 times per env.step, so one environment step advances 0.1 s of simulated time
The default horizon is 1000 environment steps
MAX_STEP is true when episode_lengths reaches the horizon
truncated is derived from the MAX_STEP entry of the step info
start_seed defaults to 0 and num_scenarios to 1
The default map is 3 blocks with lane width 3.5 and 3 lanes
close() closes the engine when one exists
The generic install requirements contain no serial, VISA, USB or vendor hardware SDK

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial lateral and heading offsets and every step is deterministic, so this package's fake repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream simulator draws from its own global random stream, so a seed need not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: kinematic/analytic model with no dynamics: positions and state transitions are integrated directly; no forces, contacts, collisions, traffic rules, map or road network are modelled

no actuator, sensor or noise model: the 259-float observation is a synthetic vector in 0..1 shaped like the default LidarStateObservation (6 ego + 10 navigation + 3 line-detector + 240 lidar values), not a rendered or ray-cast measurement
the fake integrates one 0.1 s step per tick; upstream MetaDriveEnv runs five 0.02 s physics steps per environment step (base_env.py:189-191), and the two were never compared
no rendering, image observation or panda3d engine: the fake is pure Python and imports nothing from the clone
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
reset options are accepted by the bridge but upstream MetaDriveEnv.reset only accepts seed, so the bridge falls back to seed(seed) and reset() and the options are not applied
snapshot and restore are not offered: MetaDriveEnv exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no physical device is modelled and this package was never validated against the upstream simulator or a vehicle

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
